name: gpu-widgets.md
html:
core/tokens/motion/gpu-widgets.ts

WebGPU overlay widget discriminants — the numeric kind
Sourcesrc/core/tokens/motion/gpu-widgets.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

BURGER

Nav burger hairline bars (fluid wave + breathing).

FLAG

Locale flag — wind warp + specular + split transition.

SWITCH_SLIDER

Preference toggle — pill track + per-context waveform.

THEME_SLIDER

Day/system/night slider — procedural sky scene.

CLOSE_BUTTON

Modal close — liquid fill + rotating X strokes.

MENU_BACKGROUND

Fullscreen menu backdrop — fbm contour field.

SKELETON

Loading skeleton — morphing 0/1 glyph cells.

BURN

Mosaic letter-burn — ember/char particle sim.

GPU_WIDGET_UNIFORM_F32S

Uniform f32 counts per kind — matches UNIFORM_F32S in each rust/overlay/src/widgets/<kind>.rs block-layout doc. Used by the bridge to size/settle uniform writes.

(module scope)

burger: time, res.xy, dark, rect(4).

GPU_FLAG_ANIMS

Flag animation personalities — mirrors u_anim_type in the flag shader and widgets::flag::anims in the crate.
